headword: {反復練習|はんぷくれんしゅう}
gloss: drill practice; repetitive practice; repeated exercise

definitions.gloss: drill practice; repetitive practice; repeated exercise
definitions.explanation: A learning method based on performing the same action or exercise many times to build skill or commit something to memory. Commonly applied in education, music, sports, and language learning.

examples.japanese: {反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上達|じょうたつ}する→上達する：17981_joutatsusuru⟧。

⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that repetitive practice is the most effective way to learn kanji.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{反復|はんぷく}→反復：11096_hanpuku⟧ (repetition) and ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧ (practice). Refers to a learning method based on repeating the same action many times to build skill or memory. Commonly used in education, music, sports, and language learning contexts.
